name: Takemoto Noriko
source:
MC class's class representative.
She has a calm and gentle personality, and is friendly towards all boys and girls, resulting in her being liked by everyone. She is even gentle with the class isolated MC.
Due to his misgivings, she doesn't get along well with Hasegawa.
